scope: read-only September telemetry and v1 extraction compatibility audit; no training or evaluation; auto split suggestions not adopted

method.initial_screen: existing audit_log; nearest alignment for descriptive topic/flight audit
method.compatibility: extract_trajectory_samples past-only alignment; build_window_index 101 state/100 command samples; 0.2 s stride; no saved sample dataset
method.hall_ratio: interpolated encoder count between Hall events with 0.05 < interval < 1.0 s; full log diagnostic, not training input
method.phase_check: first logged phase sample after Hall event; not an estimated zero offset
method.controls: pooled valid-core sample statistics per day, eligible logs only; reference August train only; descriptive, not causal or log-bootstrap evidence
method.rpm1: interpolated rpm_estimate times Hall interval; median near 60 suggests RPM units, provenance not firmware-verified
